description: Implementation of IQ compression and decompression functions for fixed-point and floating-point data, including quantization, packing, and resource block processing.

classes.name: iq_compression_bfp_impl
classes.description: Class implementing IQ compression and decompression algorithms using fixed-point representation.

methods.name: quantize_input
methods.description: Converts floating-point input samples to fixed-point representation and computes RMS for debugging.

methods.name: compress_prb_generic
methods.description: Compresses a resource block of quantized samples into a bit-packed format.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Performs compression of IQ data into a buffer, processing multiple resource blocks.

methods.name: decompress_prb_generic
methods.description: Decompresses a bit-packed resource block into floating-point IQ samples.

methods.name: decompress
methods.description: Decompresses entire IQ data from a compressed buffer into floating-point samples.
